title: I-IV-V-I in G major
trains: The three main chords of a key, in the order many songs use: I, IV, V, I. The thumb keeps the keynote from I to IV and finger 5 keeps the fifth from V to I; from IV to V the outer notes step down and the middle one drops a third (in C: F to D). The left hand dips a half step for V.
